notes: Primary specs (SDI I/O count, 6G-SDI ceiling, power voltage/consumption) confirmed on Blackmagic's official tech-specs page and cross-checked against Focus Camera's spec table (which also supplied dimensions ~4.8 x 3.63 x 0.9 in / 11.88 oz, not itemized on the manufacturer page). No rack ears — desktop/deskbox unit, so rackUnits omitted. SDI connector physically is BNC; grade capped at 6G-SDI per official spec (not 12G, despite "4K" in the product name — 4K support tops out at 2160p30/DCI 2160p24 over 6G-SDI). USB port's exact connector shape (Mini-B vs Micro-B) and USB revision are not stated in any source checked and are inferred by analogy to the sibling "Mini Converter HDMI to SDI 6G" catalog entry from this same product family — treat as medium confidence. Power connector is Blackmagic's proprietary/locking barrel-style DC jack; mapped to the closest available id, dc-barrel. One retailer page (soundpro.com) returned contaminated spec text (mentioning audio jacks and SDI loop-through) that does not match the official manufacturer spec or any other retailer and was discarded as unreliable/likely cross-contaminated with a different product listing on the same page.
